discussion.body: Phase art. The existing Liraen plate (tailored travel coat) is ENDGAME / late look and stays. These two are START: Valley of Songs / Iunum, early road look before Act 4 hardens her. Traditional multi-view sketch plus valley portrait. Faded teal-and-cream performance cloth, thin patched wrap, song-ribbon braid, wooden bow, song-book satchel. Traveling player, not court-elegant.
